FPNet (spectrum -> fingerprint) trained on ALL train folds incl. np-examples, same architecture as the casmi26-v4b-models engine FPNet A (drop-in).

## Licence note (updated 2026-10-13)

Weights only; the model code is the MIT-licensed `casmi` package in casmi26-v4b-models. Trained only on the competition's `train.parquet`. The competition host has clarified (discussion 745072) that `train.parquet` should be treated as open source and that datasets which are non-commercial only through `train.parquet` are fine to use.
